NONE: › the surrounding of a place by an armed force in order to defeat those defending it

example: The siege of Mafeking lasted for eight months.

The soldiers laid siege to (= started a siege of) the city.
士兵們包圍了這座城市。
The castle was under siege for months.
figurative That whole weekend at Cannes, Brigitte Bardot was under siege by photographers.
在坎城，碧姬·芭杜整個週末都被攝影師們包圍著。

NONE: › a feeling that makes you frightened of people around you, and causes you not to trust them

example: Years of international isolation has led the country to develop a siege mentality.
多年的國際封鎖導致這個國家封閉排外。
